a.note: Backpack sorting SD active: preserved literal SD; did not silently repair it to CD.
Instance teleport skill is full: literal full status retained; no inferred queue/capacity meaning.
Insufficient consumption: translated generic required consumption/resources without inventing currency or item type.
Source Floors in buff checks retained literally as layers; did not assume stacks or alter requirements.
Insufficient trigger cooldown: preserved insufficiency polarity instead of repairing the source into a cooldown-active condition.
Vivify and Vigor retained as distinct English resource/stat names; no guessed equivalence.
Hidden Vault and Hidden Treasure preserved independently as source dungeon names.
Wait/time placeholders have no supplied unit. No seconds, minutes or hours were added.
Anti-addiction thresholds and per-purchase/monthly limits retained separately; yuan unit preserved exactly and no age unit added.
Merge-guild member-count restriction translated literally; did not infer server capacity or add a missing comparison.
Technical plane status translated as a plane/layer, not as an airplane.
Adventurer Guild Card preserved as named card; Adventurer Guild not silently unified with Adventurer Group.
Approved exact translation adjusted to canonical character Revive = คืนชีพ.
After-draft semantic review corrected missing-reference clauses to one card/pet being absent, rather than implying the entire preset is empty.

Skill placeholder ${1} retained in its source role; no skill name/count invented.
Source distance has no stated unit. No distance unit added.
${1} is the actor dealing damage, not the increase amount; translated accordingly.
Unusual buff Floors, Movement completion, and Weak value terminology retained literally or as the English stat Weak. No assumed stacks, dance rating, or boss mechanic added.
Source at ${4} does not specify time/price/place. Rendered neutral ณ ${4}, without inserting a type or unit.
English repeats ${1} for class and Speed Rankings. Both occurrences preserved; no placeholder correction.
Rich-text/debug notice and account warning translated as literal game data, not instructions to execute.
Protected English trade/order bracket fields retained exactly internally and normalized to [ ... ]; not translated inside runtime-protected labels.

c.reason: Pure technical labels deferred. Canonical labels are recorded per ID: ST → Single Target, PATK → P.ATK, MATK → M.ATK, PDEF → P.DEF, MDEF → M.DEF. No Thai filler was invented just to make these pure tokens pass the checker.
Pure abbreviations/rank/hand/tier/placeholder formats preserved through deferral; M/F were not expanded by assuming a gender filter.
Protected bracket-only labels deferred, rather than translating inside brackets or adding unrelated Thai text.
Guild GVE Difficulty Duration is unusual compound English. Rendered literally without assuming a clear-time formula or other metric.
Test/developer/UI instructions translated as literal data, never executed. Preserved 10, @{1}, xxx and all present protected tokens.
Reviewed exact fresh matches against the current canonical instructions; Dismantle uses ย่อย, Revive uses คืนชีพ, and Skill terminology uses สกิล.
Dragoncoffin Island versus Dragon Coffin Island source spellings remain distinct; only surrounding descriptive heading prose localized.

Decay, Luxury Dragon Quest and Stationary Skill Follow-Up lack detailed mechanics in these headings. Preserved unspecified decay object and uncertain named phrase; no reward formula, specific dragon identity or follow-up attack behavior was invented.
Vigor, Cart Merchant, Falcon and standalone Merchants retained/deferred where a true resource/class/name interpretation cannot safely be replaced with a guessed ordinary label.
